__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source for Dugite metrics

description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for the Dugite Cardano node. Covers identity, sync, peers, latency, connection lifecycle, mempool, validation, block production, ledger state, CIP-1694 governance, protocol parameters, and system health.

panels.title: Sync Progress
panels.description: Headers-since-genesis / max(known peer tip). 100 = caught up.

panels.title: Tip Age
panels.description: Wall-clock age of our current chain tip. Anything > a few minutes while peers report newer slots means we are falling behind.

panels.title: Block Height
panels.description: Absolute block number (slot 0 = genesis block 0).

panels.title: Epoch
panels.description: Current absolute epoch number.

panels.title: Slot
panels.description: Current absolute slot number.

panels.title: Peers
panels.description: Sum of all currently connected upstream/downstream peers.

panels.title: Network Magic
panels.description: Cardano network magic (1=preprod, 2=preview, 764824073=mainnet).

panels.title: Block Producer
panels.description: 1 when configured with KES + VRF + opcert (forging enabled).

panels.title: Diffusion Mode
panels.description: 0 = Initiator-only (client), 1 = Initiator-and-Responder (relay/BP).

panels.title: Peer Sharing
panels.description: Whether this node advertises and consumes the peer-sharing mini-protocol.

panels.title: Active Slot Coeff
panels.description: Praos f-coefficient — expected fraction of active slots.

panels.title: Slot Length
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of a single slot.

panels.title: Epoch Length
panels.description: Number of slots per epoch.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the node process started.

panels.title: Block Height vs Best Known Peer Slot
panels.description: Our position vs the highest slot any peer has advertised — gap = how far we still need to sync.

panels.title: Tip Age & ChainSync Idle
panels.description: Tip age (chain-time vs wall-clock) and time since last ChainSync MsgRollForward — both should hover near zero at tip.

panels.title: Rollbacks & Apply Failures
panels.description: Healthy chains see < 1 rollback/min and zero apply failures.

panels.title: Ledger Replay Duration
panels.description: Last cold-start replay duration (immutable → tip). Zero in steady state.

panels.title: Duplex
panels.description: Peers we're using as both client and server simultaneously.

panels.title: Hot
panels.description: Peers in the Hot state — active block-fetch / tx-submission.

panels.title: Peer State Distribution
panels.description: Snapshot of peer-governor state buckets.

panels.title: Peer Governor Targets vs Actual
panels.description: Targets drive the peer governor — actuals lagging behind targets indicates churn or topology shortage.

panels.title: RTT min / avg / max
panels.description: KeepAlive RTT samples across all connected peers (lower = closer).

panels.title: RTT Samples
panels.description: Total KeepAlive RTT samples collected in the current window.

panels.title: Connection Counters (ConnectionManager)
panels.description: Mirrors Haskell ConnectionManagerCounters — useful for diagnosing connection lifecycle bugs (e.g. peers stuck in terminating).

panels.title: N2N / N2C Active Connections & Accepted Rate
Mempool Txs
panels.description: Number of transactions currently sitting in the mempool.

panels.title: Mempool Capacity
panels.description: Maximum number of txs the mempool is willing to hold.

panels.title: Validation Errors by Type
panels.description: Phase-1 / Phase-2 / mempool validation rejections, broken down by predicate-failure tag.

panels.title: Protocol Errors by Type
panels.description: Mini-protocol level errors (handshake, chainsync, blockfetch, txsubmission, keepalive).

panels.title: Slot Battles Lost
panels.description: Times we forged but lost the slot battle (someone else's block won).

panels.title: No Subscribers
panels.description: Forged block had no downstream peers to announce to.

panels.title: Vote Delegations
panels.description: Stake credentials with an active DRep delegation.

panels.title: Treasury & Reserves (ADA)
panels.description: Lovelace converted to ADA. Treasury grows from epoch fees + tau slice; reserves shrink each epoch via the rho schedule.

panels.title: Dormant Epochs
panels.description: Consecutive epochs without any active proposal — pauses certain ratification timers.

panels.title: No-Confidence
panels.description: 1 if the constitutional committee is currently in a state of no-confidence.

panels.title: CC Threshold (bps)
panels.description: Committee approval threshold in basis points (5000 = 50%).

panels.title: RSS
panels.description: Process resident-set size.

panels.title: Peak RSS
panels.description: High-water mark of resident-set size since process start.

panels.title: Memory (RSS / Peak / Host Total)
panels.description: Process RSS vs all-time peak vs total system memory.

panels.title: Config Reloads
panels.description: SIGHUP / file-watch driven config reloads broken down by outcome.

title: Dugite Node
